text:
Alice M: PD webhooks have stopped recording ack state. getting duplicates and missed escalations. started this thread so oncall handoff is tracked.
SRE Oncall Bot: Incident created: PagerDuty webhook delivery failures -> ops-webhook (sev: high). Incident ID: INC-202703-42. For details run `/incident show INC-202703-42`.
Ben K: I'm oncall. seeing a flood of alerts + duplicate incidents in PD UI. paging still triggered but acks from our ops-webhook return 401.
Carmen R: Confirmed in logs: PD -> POST https://ops-webhook.redwood.internal/alerts 401 Unauthorized starting ~04:06 UTC. Prior to that, token rotation job ran at 04:00 UTC against our IdP.
Maya S: stacktrace excerpt from our webhook logs: ```json
{"time":"2027-03-12T04:06:12Z","source":"pagerduty","status":401,"body":"invalid_auth: token expired"}
```
Dave T: Paging still goes out because PD treats deliveries as separate events; but our webhook failing to accept PD acks means PD thinks incidents remain unacked -> duplicates/escals.
Ben K: Is this PD-side token or our IdP? What integration uses the IdP?
Carmen R: We use Okta-backed OAuth for the ops-webhook's PD integration token (internal app). The token exchange failed after Okta rotated the client secret. PD requests to validate callback got 401.
Alice M: PD's webhook delivery retry policy caused a burst of retries while our webhook returned 401. Result: multiple identical incidents and paging loops.
PagerDuty Bot: Webhook delivery error: 401 Unauthorized for integration_id=INTG_0a1b2c. Delivery attempts=12. See https://support.pagerduty.com/articles/webhook-deliveries for guidance.
Maya S: Reached out to IdP (Okta) — they confirm an automated client-secret rotation ran and our app wasn't in the allowlist for automatic secrets. They rolled back but our PD integration token was still invalid.
Ben K: Immediate mitigation options? Can we flip PD to use secondary webhook endpoint or temporarily disable retries?
Carmen R: We have an alternate passive forwarder (incident-forwarder-v2) that accepts a static API key. It doesn't do ack reconciliation but will at least centralize deliveries into a single stream and avoid duplicate escalation.
Dave T: Plan: (1) Pause PD retries for integration_id INTG_0a1b2c (manual via PD UI). (2) Reconfigure PD webhook to incident-forwarder-v2. (3) Rotate and reissue a new OAuth client secret for the ops-webhook and update PD integration. (4) Monitor.
Ben K: I'll do (1) and (2). Carmen, can you handle (3) with Okta? Alice, help with (4) and notifying customers.
Alice M: Notifying customers: send short status update to status.redwood.ai and post to #customer-notifications. Template: "We're investigating increased duplicate alerts and delayed acknowledgements; root cause tied to third-party auth rotation affecting our PagerDuty webhook. Mitigation in progress."
SRE Oncall Bot: Handoff note: Ben K taking active remediation. Expected next oncall update in 30m.
Ben K: Paused retries in PD UI — status shows retries paused for integration INTG_0a1b2c. Repointing to incident-forwarder-v2 now. Posting curl we used: ```bash
curl -X PUT "https://api.pagerduty.com/integrations/INTG_0a1b2c" 
 -H 'Authorization: Token token=REDACTED' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{"integration": {"url": "https://incident-forwarder-v2.redwood.internal/pd"}}'
```
Carmen R: Okta: rotating client secret now and whitelisting automated rotation for that service. I'll update our secret in Vault and then update PD. Estimated complete in 10 minutes.
Maya S: In the mean time, I'm manually silencing noisy PD escalation policies for affected service groups to reduce user-facing duplicate pages. Policy IDs: SVC-ops, SVC-runtime.
Dave T: Two follow-ups: (a) runbook gap — our runbook doesn't have explicit steps for IdP-initiated secret rotations impacting PD; add it. (b) add a health check to fail open/closed semantics so PD knows when ack can't be reconciled.
Alice M: Status update for customers drafted and published to status.redwood.ai: "Mitigation underway: failing over PagerDuty webhook to a backup forwarder and reissuing OAuth credentials. No data lost; some customers may have received duplicate pages. We will update when normal operations resume." Posted to #customer-notifications.
PagerDuty Bot: Support ticket PD-TCKT-7891 opened with PagerDuty support referencing webhook delivery 401s and integration INTG_0a1b2c. Severity: high.
Ben K: Updated PD integration with new client secret after Carmen uploaded secret to Vault. Doing a small end-to-end smoke test: trigger test alert -> should hit incident-forwarder-v2 and ack flows.
Maya S: Phone pages re-enabled for critical oncall for the next 20 minutes in case PD still misroutes.
Ben K: Test alert: triggered, received by incident-forwarder-v2, acked via internal console, PD status shows acknowledged. No duplicate escalation so far.
Carmen R: Okta confirms rotation completed and new secret active. We updated PD integration to use the refreshed token and verified token introspection passes.
Dave T: Monitoring: added a temporary CloudWatch/Prometheus alert on webhook 401 rate > 1/min to catch regressions. Also added PD delivery-success-rate dashboard tile.
Alice M: Good job everyone. Next steps: (owner - ETA) 1) Runbook update (Dave T - 24h), 2) Add integration health check + fallback docs (Carmen R - 48h), 3) Postmortem and timeline (Ben K/Alice M - draft in 48h), 4) Customer follow-up message with root-cause (Alice M - after postmortem).
SRE Oncall Bot: Incident INC-202703-42 status -> mitigated. Please transition to postmortem channel when ready.
Ben K: Handing off to dayshift. I'll add my notes to the incident doc and include the curl commands and the Okta rollback timeline. Oncall handoff: @Carmen R you have the lead for cleanups.
Carmen R: Acknowledged. I'll own cleanup and runbook PR.
Alice M: Leaving final sign-off: ops are back to normal from customer-impact perspective. We'll keep monitoring for 24h. Thanks all. :tada:
PagerDuty Bot: Note: If you changed integration credentials, consider revoking old tokens and rotating any related API keys.
